scientific_integrity: One coherent theorem of exact mean/variance-information equivalence, sharp six-site nonidentifiability, constructive persistent ambiguity and variance envelope. Unrestricted statements rest on algebraic and combinatorial proofs; exhaustive tests through order seven are separate finite corroboration. Independently unaudited. Novelty carries residual risk from unindexed sampling and graph-polynomial specializations.
scientific_limitations: Fixed connected tree incidence, exactly two distinct sites per species, uniform sampling without replacement of fixed-size site subsets. Does not describe model-based estimator uncertainty, weighted networks or general incidence matrices. Degree-based variance extrema have established mathematical precedents and are not presented as independently new.
title: Sharp six-site limit of moment-based rarefaction in tree-incidence communities
